subject: SIG / CAIQ pre-call: scheduling, log access, and demo scope
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@novahealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ pre-call: scheduling, log access, and demo scope

Hi Ben —

Thanks for reaching out. We are ready to kick off the SIG/CAIQ intake. A couple quick constraints from our side:
- We need the intake call to include a short demo of the Redwoods inference console (10–12 min).
- Our DevOps team will only grant read-only access to logs for a 48-hr window during the runbook demo. Who should we give the temporary access to?

My availability: Tues (7/20) 9:00–11:00 PT or Wed (7/21) 10:00–12:00 PT. Please confirm a time and share the list of documents you’ll ask for so we can surface them ahead of the call.

Attachments: novahealth_sig_matrix_v1.xlsx (our prefilled matrix)

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Head of Security, NovaHealth
laura.chen@novahealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ pre-call: scheduling, log access, and demo scope

Laura —

Appreciate the note and the prefilled matrix — very helpful. Wed 7/21 10:00–11:00 PT works well for our team.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- Demo: we'll do a focused 12-minute live walk (Console -> model routing -> logs sample). Marissa will drive the demo.
- Log access window: understood. For the demo we need read-only access to the following log slices: inference-requests.log (last 7 days), per-tenant audit.log (last 30 days), and a short sample of tokenization traces. If your DevOps can share a temporary S3 presigned URL or a secure transfer link for a 48-hour window that’s ideal.

I've attached our suggested evidence checklist and a short PDF with redwood runbook steps so your team can plan the access window.

Proposed agenda (12–40 min total):
1) Intros + scope (5 min)
2) Console demo & routing example (12 min)
3) CAIQ/SIG Q&A — focus on logging, key management, and data residency (15 min)
4) Next steps & artifact handoff (3 min)

I'll send the calendar invite with dial-in now.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-log-sample-instructions.pdf, redwood-demo-credentials-stub.txt

From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@novahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-20T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ pre-call: scheduling, log access, and demo scope

Ben / Marissa —

Confirmed: Wed 7/21 10:00–11:00 PT works for the NovaHealth security intake team.
A couple items from DevOps:
- We will provide a limited S3 presigned bucket with the requested logs. Please confirm the exact object prefixes you need by EOD so we can prepare the export job.
- We cannot share tokenization traces that include raw PII. If you need trace format, we can provide a sanitized sample with identifiers hashed.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood will require access to any of our KMS keys or just metadata about key rotation?

Thanks,
Alex Ruiz
Cloud Engineering Manager — NovaHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@novahealth.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@novahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-20T10:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ pre-call: scheduling, log access, and demo scope

Alex / Laura —

Thanks for the confirmation and the constraints — totally understood on PII. Quick clarifications from our side before the call so we can ask the right questions and avoid follow-ups:
- Log prefixes: please provide inference-requests/* and audit/tenant-*/ (last 7 and 30 days, respectively). If you can give a single top-level prefix we can pull by path.
- Tokenization traces: a sanitized example is perfect. We only need format + field names; we will never ask for raw PII.
- KMS: we do not need your KMS keys. We only need description of key rotation cadence, who holds key custody, and whether any HSM-backed keys are used for the tenant-level envelope keys.

We'll keep the demo environment read-only and use only the artifacts you provide. On the call we'll also show an example CAIQ response mapping so you can see how Redwood populates control evidence.

See the amended agenda below; we'll keep the live demo to 12 minutes and prioritize CAIQ questions after.

Agenda (Wed 7/21, 10:00 PT)
- 10:00 — 10:05: Introductions & scope (Ben)
- 10:05 — 10:17: Console demo + logs walkthrough (Marissa)
- 10:17 — 10:32: CAIQ/SIG Q&A (Soojin)
- 10:32 — 10:40: Next steps & artifact handoff (Ben)

Looking forward to it — we’ll send the ics and the call recording consent clause shortly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security Solutions — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novahealth.com>, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-21T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ pre-call: scheduling, log access, and demo scope

Laura / Alex —

Thanks again for getting the slots lined up. Calendar invite sent for Wed 7/21 10:00 PT (attached as calendar-invite.ics). A couple requested pre-call asks to make the hour productive:
- Please upload inference-requests/* and audit/tenant-*/ logs to the presigned S3 prefix: s3://novahealth-sig-temp/exports/ (we'll pull via the pre-signed urls). If you can't do the full range, please at least include a 24-hr sample for each prefix.
- Provide the sanitized tokenization trace sample (format-only) to the same bucket.
- If you have an internal CAIQ worksheet, include that in the folder so we can map answers during the Q&A.

We will not request key material or live KMS credentials. The attached PDF is our runbook for the demo and the Excel is a Redwood mapping template — feel free to prefill any rows you like.

See you on Wednesday — invite dial-in + recording consent in the ics.

Cheers,
Ben

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics
